description: A threat-model artifact enumerates security threats for a feature using STRIDE classification, risk scoring, and explicit mitigations linked to downstream security compilers.

rules.description: The threat model must identify the feature it covers.
The assets array must be non-empty — at least one asset under threat must be declared.
The trust_boundaries array must be present (may be empty only if the feature has no trust boundary crossings).
The threats array must be present.
Each threat must declare: id, title, stride_category, affected_component, likelihood, impact.
stride_category must be one of: Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information_Disclosure, Denial_of_Service, Elevation_of_Privilege.
likelihood and impact must each be integers 1–5. If risk_score is declared, it must equal likelihood × impact.
Every threat with risk score ≥ 15 must have at least one mitigation with a description, or a waiver_ref pointing to an approved exception record.
Every declared asset must appear as the affected_component in at least one threat.
Each trust boundary must declare 'from' and 'to' fields identifying the zones that it separates.
Each declared mitigation must include either a compiler_ref (e.g. 'authz-policy') or a mechanism field describing the control.
If the feature uses LLM or AI, the threat model must include threats addressing prompt injection and data exfiltration.
